---
name: False Positive / Blocking Issue
about: Report unintended traffic impact from a generated policy
title: "false-positive: "
labels: bug, safety
---

## Policy / recipe

Name or link to the recipe, domain, ASN, or generated policy.

## RouterOS version

Example: RouterOS 7.x

## What was blocked unexpectedly?

Describe the affected service or destination.

## Expected behavior

What should remain reachable?

## Evidence

Include sanitized logs, domains, IP/CIDR evidence, or a minimal reproduction. Never include credentials, public IPs, or private topology unless necessary and sanitized.

## Rollback status

Did removing the generated address-list/rule restore service?
